rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs sponsored by AVMA, AVMA-recognized allied associations and specialty boards, state or local veterinary associations, accredited veterinary schools, Board-approved associations or courses, AAVSB RACE, USDA, state fish and game or public health agencies
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: 5 contact hours for each complete calendar year licensed during the concluding licensing period.
rules.audit_note: Board may require additional evidence; keep proof for 3 years.
rules.notes: Alaska licenses veterinary technicians (biennial). At least two-thirds of hours must be medical programs; up to one-third non-medical. No online limit stated. Exact expiration date not confirmed on the rule pages read.
